# agyn_group (Resource)

Manages an Agyn group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier for the group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `external_id` (String) External identity-provider group identifier.
- `source` (String) Group source. One of `platform` or `scim`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the group.
